item.g:title: UNO (Flip)
item.g:description: UNO Flip is a dynamic twist on the classic UNO game featuring a double-sided deck with a Light Side and a Dark Side. Players start on the Light Side with typical colors (blue, green, yellow, red) and milder action cards such as Draw One and Wild Draw Two. When a Flip card is played, the entire deck and players' hands flip to the Dark Side, which has more intense colors (pink, teal, purple, orange) and stronger action cards including Draw Five, Skip Everyone, and Wild Draw Color. The objective remains the same as original UNO: to be the first to get rid of all your cards and score points based on opponents' remaining cards. The game involves strategic play between the two sides, with each side having unique rules and tougher penalties on the Dark Side. Players must adapt quickly as the deck flips back and forth during the game, keeping the action unpredictable and exciting. Key features: Double-sided deck with Light and Dark sides Special Flip cards that switch game sides mid-play Unique action cards on each side with escalating penalties Designed for 2 to 10 players, suitable for ages 7 and up Points scored at each round based on cards left in opponents’ hands First to 500 points wins
